body.faq_description: Expert answers about web development, AI solutions, ecommerce, SEO and our process for businesses worldwide.

faqs.question: Why choose IGENTX over other web development companies?
faqs.answer: IGENXT combines AI-accelerated delivery with enterprise-grade engineering practices. Unlike template agencies, we build custom solutions on modern stacks like Next.js and React, optimised for performance, SEO and scalability from day one. Our team delivers multilingual, globally deployable solutions, and we measure success by business outcomes: leads, conversions and operational efficiency, not just launch dates. You work with one team from strategy through launch and ongoing growth.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups and enterprises?
faqs.answer: Yes. For startups, we focus on fast MVP delivery, clear scope and foundations that scale. For enterprises, we emphasise architecture, security, integrations and phased rollouts. Our process adapts to your team size, budget and timeline, from a single landing page to multi-language platforms with headless CMS, ecommerce and AI automation. Contact us for a scoped proposal based on your goals.

faqs.question: How long does website development take?
faqs.answer: Timeline depends on scope: a focused marketing site typically takes 2-4 weeks; larger corporate or ecommerce projects take 4-8 weeks. Factors include page count, integrations, multilingual requirements and content readiness. Our seven-step process includes discovery, strategy, design, development, QA, launch and ongoing growth, with clear milestones at each stage. We provide a realistic timeline after a brief discovery call.

faqs.question: Can you redesign an existing website?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We migrate and redesign existing sites, including WordPress, Shopify and custom builds, to modern architectures without losing SEO equity when planned correctly. A redesign typically improves page speed, mobile experience, conversion paths and search visibility. We audit your current site, preserve valuable content and URLs, and rebuild with performance and accessibility built in from the start.

faqs.question: How does your AI Customer Service Agent work?
faqs.answer: Our AI agent is trained on your website content, documents and FAQs using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It answers visitor questions instantly, qualifies leads and supports multilingual conversations. Integration takes one line of code on any website. You control the knowledge base, review conversations and update content as your business evolves.

faqs.question: Is the AI Customer Service Agent multilingual?
faqs.answer: Yes. The agent supports multilingual conversations so visitors can get accurate responses in their preferred language. This is valuable for businesses serving diverse local and international audiences.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: Technical SEO improvements can show indexing and speed gains within weeks. Meaningful ranking improvements for competitive keywords typically take 3-6 months with consistent content and authority building. Local SEO for location-specific queries may show faster results in regional markets. We set realistic expectations, track progress monthly and focus on qualified traffic that converts, not vanity metrics.

faqs.question: Do you provide local SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. We optimise Google Business Profile, local citations, multilingual landing pages, and location-specific schema markup. Local search benefits from mobile-first performance, culturally relevant content and strong technical foundations. We help businesses rank for regional queries while supporting broader international visibility.

faqs.question: Shopify vs BigCommerce: which is right for my business?
faqs.answer: Shopify excels for fast setup, app ecosystem and smaller-to-mid catalogues. BigCommerce suits larger catalogues, B2B features and headless commerce flexibility. We assess your product count, integration needs, customisation requirements and growth plans to recommend the right platform, or a headless approach with Next.js storefront for maximum performance and design freedom.

faqs.question: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing support packages covering security updates, performance monitoring, content changes, feature iterations and SEO optimisation. Websites and applications need continuous care, including plugin updates, dependency patches and analytics review. We tailor support to your needs, from ad-hoc hours to monthly retainers with SLA response times.
